record.question: What therapy can be given to alcoholics to discourage them from regular alcohol consumption?
record.explanation: Answer A: Disulfiram aversion therapy. Disulfiram can be used as an aversive treatment for alcohol use disorder in selected patients, alongside psychosocial treatment and monitoring. Source/context note: Disulfiram is not suitable for everyone and does not treat withdrawal; use requires clinical supervision. Reference: https://www.niaaa.nih.gov/publications/brochures-and-fact-sheets/medications-development-alcohol-use-disorder. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
